Al-Yamamah Enterprise  Employment Application and Terms

Article 1: The company retains all submitted
candidate records and application files  indefinitely in our archival
database following the conclusion of the recruitment cycle, and reserves the right to  store this information permanently
for future operational reference.

Article  2: To evaluate candidacy for the applied position,
applicants are
strictly required to  submit  their  full national identification card copy, religious affiliation, marital status, exact number of family dependents, and current employer

Article 3: This application procedure and all associated evaluation terms shall be  governed by  and construed in accordance with  the commercial laws applicable within the  Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Article 4: All formal notices, interview  schedules,
and official communications related to this application shall be delivered electronically to the primary email address provided by the candidate.

Article 5: All proprietary assessment  materials, employer tests, and
proprietary evaluation frameworks

application process remain the exclusive intellectual property of the
company.

Article 6: For  the purposes  of  this document,  Company refers to Al-Yamamah Enterprise, and Applicant refers to the individual submitting their  credentials for employment consideration.

Article 7: The company assumes no financial or operational liability for any technical disruptions, transmission delays,  or data interception
occurrences during the online submission process.

Article 8: All  application review fees are strictly non-refundable and must be settled prior
to  the initial
